summary: The planner now sizes each step by what it has to decide instead of by tool calls: a design gets its own step before anything is built, pieces that belong together stay with one helper, and you see the whole plan (how many helpers, on which model, what each designs or builds) and can cut or split steps before any helper starts. A design you will look at waits for your OK, the 64k cap on one reply from 1.0.104 is taken out again, and the board cleanup reminder is gone.
